title: Hybrid DAG 示例：Pi 只读契约 + 并行侦察 + Pi 写入配置实现
objective: 演示 v2 hybrid DAG：Pi 节点返回只读契约/审查结论，Pi writer 节点通过 toolProfile=write 执行受控独占实现，shell 节点负责确定性验证。
successCriteria: contract-pi 返回可审计的只读实现契约摘要
scout-src 与 scout-tests 并行只读侦察且互不写冲突
implement-core 仅在声明的 writeSet 内修改代码
review-pi 基于上游输出完成只读审查
verify-shell 归档确定性验证命令输出
dag validate 校验通过且 ranks 符合依赖拓扑
globalConstraints: Do not commit runtime traces under .harness/dag-runs/
Do not enable cross-node Pi runtime reuse by default
Preserve CODE_AGENT_PI_BACKEND=cli-only rollback for Pi nodes
Every task must explicitly declare executor; defaults.executor is schema-only and not a runtime fallback
Prefer same-rank parallel read-only scouts over serial chains when outputs are independent
Add depends_on only when a child truly needs upstream output; challenge single-chain topologies during review
Same-rank exclusive writeSet entries must be disjoint
exclusive implementer nodes must use narrow, concrete writeSet paths; never use ** or repo root
Cursor remains an explicit optional executor; no-Cursor environments use Pi read-only scouts and Pi writer nodes with toolProfile=write
Read-only nodes must not write root artifacts/**; root artifacts/ is reserved for explicit exclusive write nodes

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown implementation contract summary; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: 阅读 ./README.md 与 docs/agent-dag-runner.md，返回 10 行以内的实现契约摘要（只读分析 + 文档建议，不改代码/文档/artifacts）。指出是否适合并行 scout 与窄 writeSet。

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown reconnaissance summary of DAG-related source modules; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: 只读审计 ./src/workflows/dag/ 中与 DAG 相关的模块，列出关键文件与职责（不要改文件）。

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown test coverage gap summary; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: 只读审计 ./test/ 中与 dag-runner 相关的测试覆盖，列出缺口建议（不要改文件）。

tasks.outputContract: Implementation summary with changed files, tests run, and residual risks.
tasks.subtask_prompt: 基于上游侦察结果，在 writeSet 范围内做最小必要改动并说明风险（若无需改动则输出 no-op 理由）。

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown review summary; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: 审查上游实现与侦察结论是否一致，列出范围漂移、验证缺口与残余风险（只读，不改文件/文档/artifacts）。

tasks.outputContract: Archived shell verification stdout/stderr with exit codes; no worktree writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Run deterministic loop-agent verification and archive command outputs.
